_comment: Volatility tiers for the skill-fact-check routine. Methodology lives in the skill at plugins/marketplace-kit/skills/skill-fact-check/SKILL.md. unit_id = <plugin>/<skill>. Every unit is listed explicitly — npm run structure:check reports when one is missing; an unlisted unit still safely defaults to monthly. Re-tier by moving a unit_id between the lists. Vendored skill copies (a skill generated into a plugin that isn't its author — see vendored-skills.json) are tiered 'never': the routine corrects the authoritative source, and npm run sync propagates the fix to every copy.
